description.narrative: The project will promote and finance commercial agribusiness enterprises collective owned by small farmers (collective enterprises) and individual small enterprises (individual enterprises) through Small Farmers Development Bank (SFDB), an apex development bank owned by Small Farmers Agriculture Cooperatives (SFACs). SFDB provides wholesale loans to SFACs; then SFACs relend to their small famer members. Under the project, SFACs will relend the loan proceeds to their members' collective enterprises and individual enterprises.
